Results.ReviewText: This grill replaced my old Spirit e-210 which I’ve had for over 10 years. The old grill still works. I needed an upgrade. It was very easy to assemble. You have to be patient. Weber has set the bar high with their gas grills. This grill cooks evenly and has all the features I need. I also own a Smokey Joe and plan on purchasing the 22”Kettle charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Love my Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill.  So far good, seems the quality is good
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.ReviewText: High quality BBQ that can be used for all year with multiple purposes.
Results.Title: Top Performance BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Gets very hot and cooks well. Grates are very difficult to clean and as a result, food sticks. Construction feels a bit flimsy for a premium brand so we’ll see how well it holds up over time.
Results.Title: I still have my old grill right next to this one

Results.ReviewText: easy to use and clean, temperature help with the cooking
Results.Title: weber gas grill

Results.ReviewText: This is our first Weber Grill.  Have really enjoyed it so far.  Propane tank can be a challenge to install.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I am so glad you asked for my review. I have purchased two weber grills since 5-23-23. The first one a Spirit E-310, serial number EC3008429 has been problematic. I have already replaced the gas regulator a few months ago and it will not start again (maybe the regulator again). Please help.
Results.Title: Grill not operational

Results.ReviewText: I love the grill. I use it twice a week. Easy to clean and cooks evenly.  I would recommend to anyone.
Results.Title: Easy peasy.

Results.ReviewText: Lights right up.. cooks great.. I do not like the tank setup.. you have to lift the tank and hang it on a scale.. not an easy feat for a 77 year old.. my old weber had the tank just sit in an opening.. much easier to install..
Results.Title: The good and bad

Results.ReviewText: Overall a very nice gas grill. Electric start works well and grill heats up quickly. 4 stars only due to the issues with suspending the gas tank while trying to hook it up to the gas level scale- hard to do alone. Otherwise it's a 5 star performing grill.
Results.Title: New Spirit E-310 review

Results.ReviewText: It was easy enough to put together. The igniter does not work, but an easy light with a lighter. I'm not happy with the delivery issues that I had with Home Depot.  I thought i was going to get the grill the next day and I paid extra for it.  They sent me the aluminum drip pans only.  Three days later I received the cover and it took a week for the grill to arrive.  I thought I was going to get it before July 4th not July 6th.  It is hard for me to put the tank on the bar that measures fullness of the propane.  So I usually give higher ratings, but I can't in this case.
Results.Title: Why are grills not built to last anymore....

Results.ReviewText: Solid and stable; the Weber Spirit always delivers controled and easy cooking/grilling.
Results.Title: The Goat

Results.ReviewText: We were having a large family gathering with over 50 people and we suddenly felt as though the E-310 would serve us perfectly grilling the meat and corn for our guests. It proved absolutely wonderful and we are pleased.
Results.Title: Grilling for 50

Results.ReviewText: Weber customer service was easy to reach by phone and helpful in replacing the leaking regulator and hose part that was still under warranty after 2 years.
Results.Title: Excellent warranty part service.

Results.ReviewText: Best barbecue I bought. Good control of heat and even distribution on grill surface.
Results.Title: Performance

Results.ReviewText: You won’t be disappointed with this great grill! Wonderful results, easy to light and use.
Results.Title: Weber is tops!!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill.  But , Weber unfortunatley changed the back panel, reducing its size to a 1/4 height and thus leaving most of the back open to the elements.    Not a good change in our opinion, as it is now harder to keep the inside area clean of insects, etc (even with a grill cover).  Weber did not update their brochure and online details with this change either.   Given all that, Weber has been very responsive to our queries on getting a 3/4 length back panel.
Results.Title: Great grill with one design issue

Results.ReviewText:
Very easy to assemble. My 9 year old son and I did it in about an hour.
Grill is great - heats quickly and holds heat for great cooking. Love it!!!!
Results.Title: Assembly and use

Results.ReviewText: Life long Weber customer.  The back panel, which used to come up above the drip tray, now covers only the lower 1/3 of the back of the grill.  As a result, wind affects the burners easily.  The model on the floor had the larger back panel.  Complained to True Value hardware, who complained to Weber rep, who was aware of the change and has received many complaints.  Rep ordered the larger back panel but it is, of course, back ordered.  Shame on Weber for trying to make yourself a few extra bucks, while increasing the price of your grills!!!
Results.Title: Smaller back panel

Results.ReviewText: Love my new Weber grill. It cooks everything so fast and tender.
Results.Title: Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: I like my new Weber grill. It's a lot better than any grill I've owned in the past. It seems sturdy and well made and it certainly is easy to cook great meals on.
Results.Title: My First Weber

Results.ReviewText: Even cooking, easy to use. This grill replace a very old Weber Grill which had very heavy use.  These grills are workhorses and I highly recommend them. If you take care of the grill as described in the directions, this grill be take of you.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText:
Happy with my grill the way it cooks evenly.  The only thing I am waiting for is the backing!  When purchased it did not come with it.  I was told to call customer service to request it.  It is a part they no longer build with it. 
Customer service had it on back order and they will send it directly to my home when supply is in.
Results.Title: BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Very nice grill.  The third burner makes a world of difference when grilling
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Weber. Had first one 30 years....passed it on the granddaughter.  She loves it.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: We have had similar Weber grills in the past and all perform well. They are relatively esay to clean. We bought the Spirit E-310 through. local box store and they assembled it. When we got it home the regulator leaked no matter what--we tried different tanks. We called WEber service and they immediately offered to replace the part. That seemed great. 12 days later we STILL didn't have the part and hadn't been able to use the grill at all. I contacted service and they said, "gee, we just mailed that part TODAY" 12 days after I called?! When the paart came it seems the box store installed one piece upside down and that made a 5 minute switch out take over an hour. So, a defective part  (regulator) resulted in a 2 week delay of use and a super frustrating hour coaxing the old regulator off the grill.
Results.Title: Defective Regulator Valve and SLOW replacement

Results.ReviewText: The grill is great,  heats fast,  is easy to clean and holds the heat very well.  The double side tables makes cooking super efficient along with holding the tools I need.  The tool hooks are handy as well.
Results.Title: I Love My Grill!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve owned a lot of grills in my life and so far this one does not disappoint.
Results.Title: Best grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber is in a league of their own. Beat propane grill
Results.Title: Top-notch

Results.ReviewText: After having my original grill for almost 10 years when it was time to replace, I went with the Spirit E 310. It’s the perfect size for me and meet all my grilling needs.
Results.Title: Love this grill!

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill but would recommend the burners be horizontal rather than vertical.  Then it would be much easier to cook beer can chickens from side to side on the grill rather than front to back.
Results.Title: Burner Recommendation

Results.ReviewText: The flavorizer bars have been replaced twice in 3 years. They completely rotted out. The metal coating on the grates started to peel off in year 3. Who wants to eat metal with their burger??We asked Weber for a replacement-no response. They are supposed to be warrantied for 5 years.
Results.Title: Metal peeling from grill grates?

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill..High Quality...very even heat..superb fit and finish
Results.Title: Weber doesn't disappoint

Results.ReviewText: Weber's grill build quality is only exceeded by their customer support. My 10-ish year old Spirit E-310 developed a warped cookbox this summer (probably from when I left it on overnight by accident), and once I was able to send the serial number (which was hard to locate) from the grill to customer support, they immediately sent me a brand new cookbox with easy-to-follow instructions to replace teh warped one. Absolutely tremendous support!
Results.Title: Customer Support is even better than this grill

Results.ReviewText: Grill heat quickly and evenly.  Lights all burners perfectly every time.  Seems well-built and I hope it lasts longer than the cheap grills I have had in the past.
Results.Title: Solid reliable

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love this grill. Cooks evenly, great heat control,  easy to clean. And it was a great price
Results.Title: Amazing Grill

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
